test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f334601ef5a1ee3f7f4f7db012dc62a14b86fc80a400b53ce2c369c2418f1e1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27041a24578c2fee5a2898a2432c2488d96bdc5a6c6e24e2d05539df40817f0a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

Top- left and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

Bottom-right and top-right symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

**From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:**

Top- left and top-right symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

Bottom-left and bottom-right symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383e71c6c6478d45acbd9b5229e4a81d1ffa621ce1bd1ef7598de3bc9fd559a6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5c22f3e71e9324daf9c9720bcd5aee4e442a28d4db42eb8e65cc400710846d3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
